scope: Consumed independent development semantic family; actual new image-only PDF endpoint, not a held-out qualification cohort

input.representation: Independently generated lossless image-only PDF embedding the original 1x raster; separate vector Reader control never an OCR source
input.sourcePixelIdentity: Generator pins original PNG decoded pixels; actual PDF 1x rendering comparison records equality or mismatch before OCR

planning.input: Actual coarse PDF raster rules only; metadata extent from original nonwhite pixels above measured band
planning.selection: Unique minimum-height adjacent five-cell closed band; common supporting vertical rails extend to the same physical bottom rail
planning.failure: Ambiguous, incomplete, oversized, out-of-bounds or cancelled plan stops without OCR; no drawing/gold/text role input
planning.workPolicy: Single nonreset budget charges rail inventory, edge construction, conservative sort work and all support/coverage comparisons; cancellation checked every128

render.detailClaim: 2x rendering interpolates the original 1x raster; no new source detail
render.coordinateReceipt: One exact affine: localX=s*(originalX-boxX), localY=s*(originalY-boxY)+(ceil(boxHeight*s)-boxHeight*s). Inverse uses actual scalar and ceil padding, never width/height-ratio approximation.

recognition.minimumHeightPolicy: Verify this equals the supported SDK request default before any perform; no lowering
recognition.supportedLanguagesPolicy: Query actual supportedRecognitionLanguages before any perform; requested languages must be supported
recognition.requestPolicy: Exactly one request per frozen derived region, maximum seven; no page-wide request, loop, retry, crop sweep or candidate adoption
recognition.confidencePolicy: Finite candidate confidence 0.85 through 1 unchanged; cross-API calibration not assumed
recognition.rangePolicy: Unmodified per-Swift-Character native range boxes; accurate word precision is not relabelled precise glyph ink
recognition.regionProvenancePolicy: Additional strict local right/bottom <= actual CGImage dimensions; raw out-of-ROI ranges retained and refused even if inverse falls inside whole page. No clipping/tolerance.

accounting.wholePage: Original 1x raster and inverse-mapped actual native boxes; existing full-page RecoveryRasterGrid guard within 4096 dimensions, no tile proof substitution
accounting.uniqueOwner: Additional diagnostic accounts original nonrule pixels by actual returned candidate ranges; same-candidate character ranges share a candidate owner, cross-candidate overlap refuses
accounting.guards: Original confidence/range, cancellation, work budget, physical ownership and complete raster coverage; missing periods/classes/roles never filled
accounting.partialSource: Actual Reader capture/refusal preserved separately; returned regional observations alone never promote a partial source
accounting.oracle: Assertion after actual Analysis only; no drawing roles, source cell indices, class/day/period gold or blank flags to OCR/Builder
accounting.formalQuality: UNASSESSED: ordinary Text adapter/region acquisition and manual confirmation/storage are not automatically production-qualified

privacy: Source-only generator/helper; no PDF/PNG/font binaries in Git; entire image-bearing native input records excluded from public selected output
